qe: In 1857 the garrison at Dinapore included which European regiment, along with a company of European artillery and a company of Native artillery?
qh: 1857 में दानापुर की छावनी में यूरोपीय तोपखाने की एक कंपनी तथा देशी तोपखाने की एक कंपनी के साथ कौन-सी यूरोपीय रेजिमेंट शामिल थी?
e: 1857 me Dinapore ki chhawni angreji sena ka bada kendra thi. Wahan 10th Foot (ek European regiment) tatha European artillery ki ek company ke saath Native artillery ki ek company tatha Indian infantry ki 7th, 8th tatha 40th battalions rakhi gayi thi. Isi daur me Patna asantusht Muhammadan logon ki saazish ka kendra bana hua tha tatha Commissioner William Tayler ko kshetra ki suraksha sambhalni padi thi. Aage jab halat bigdi, to Lloyd ki sena ko 87th Foot ki do companies se mazboot kiya gaya. Is tarah Patna kshetra me 1857 ke vidroh ka sambandh Dinapore ki chhawni tatha shahar ke saazishkaron dono se tha. Exam point: 1857 me Dinapore ki chhawni me 10th Foot, European artillery ki ek company, Native artillery ki ek company tatha Indian infantry ki 7th, 8th tatha 40th battalions thi; Patna us daur saazish ka kendra tha tatha aage Lloyd ki sena ko 87th Foot ki do companies milin.

qe: On 18 June 1857, Commissioner William Tayler arrested the three Maulavis who were at the head of which body in Patna?
qh: 18 जून 1857 को कमिश्नर विलियम टेलर ने उन तीन मौलवियों को गिरफ्तार किया, जो पटना के किस समूह के प्रमुख थे?
e: 1857 me Patna asantusht Muhammadan logon ki saazish tatha sadyantra ka kendra bana hua tha, isliye Commissioner William Tayler ko kshetra me sakht nigrani rakhni padi thi. 18 June 1857 ko Tayler ne Patna ke Wahabi samuday ke teen Maulaviyon ko, jo us giroh ke pramukh the, giraftar kar liya. Unhe isliye bandi banaya gaya ki unke anuyayi achha vyavhar karein tatha koi bada vidroh na karein; doosre shabdon me unhe bandhak bana kar rakha gaya. Isi daur me 7 June ko Bankipore ke European nivasi suraksha ke liye Chajju Bagh me ikattha hue the tatha 8 June ko Captain Rattray apne Sikh sipahiyon ke saath pahunche the. Exam point: 18 June 1857 ko Commissioner William Tayler ne Patna ke Wahabi samuday ke teen Maulaviyon ko giraftar kar bandhak ke roop me rakha; Patna us samay asantusht Muhammadan logon ki saazish ka kendra tha; 7-8 June ko Bankipore ke European nivasi Chajju Bagh me surakshit hue the.

qe: On 3 July 1857, sixty or seventy men with drums beating and the green flag waving suddenly rushed to attack which building in Patna city?
qh: 3 जुलाई 1857 को ढोल बजाते तथा हरा झंडा लहराते साठ-सत्तर लोग अचानक पटना शहर के किस भवन पर हमला करने दौड़े?
e: 18 June 1857 ko Patna ke Wahabi Maulaviyon ki giraftari ke baad bhi shahar me tanav bana raha. 3 July 1857 ko saath-saath yaani sattar ke aas-paas Muhammadan log, jinke saath dhol baj rahe the tatha hara jhanda lehra raha tha, achanak Patna shahar ke Roman Catholic girjaghar par hamla karne ke liye daude. Commissioner William Tayler ne turant Patna me maujood Captain Rattray ke Sikh sipahiyon ko wahin bheja. Opium Factory ke Superintendent Dr. Lyell ne socha ki unki upasthiti bhid ko dara degi, isliye woh Sikhon se aage badh gaye; unke paas pahunchne par kai goliyaan chalayi gayin tatha woh ghayal ho kar shaheed ho gaye. Us samay halat bahut naazuk thi, lekin Sikh sipahi pahunch gaye tatha bhid ko jaldi bitha diya. Exam point: 3 July 1857 ko dhol tatha hare jhande ke saath sattar ke aas-paas logon ne Patna ke Roman Catholic girjaghar par hamla kiya; Dr. Lyell goli lagne se ghayal ho kar shaheed ho gaye; Rattray ke Sikh sipahiyon ne bhid ko bitha diya.

qe: Which officer, the Superintendent of the Opium Factory at Patna, was mortally wounded on 3 July 1857 while riding ahead to overawe the rioters?
qh: पटना की अफीम फैक्ट्री के अधीक्षक कौन-से अफसर 3 जुलाई 1857 को दंगाइयों को डराने के लिए आगे बढ़ने पर गोली लगने से घायल हो गए?
e: 1857 me Patna kshetra me afim ka vyapar bahut bada tha, isliye yahan Opium Factory ke Superintendent Dr. Lyell ek mahatvapurn adhikari the. 3 July 1857 ko jab dhol tatha hare jhande ke saath sattar ke aas-paas log Roman Catholic girjaghar par hamla karne daude, to Commissioner Tayler ne Captain Rattray ke Sikh sipahiyon ko wahin bheja. Dr. Lyell ne socha ki ek bade adhikari ko dekhte hi bhid piche hat jaayegi, isliye woh Sikhon se aage badh gaye; unke paas pahunchne par goliyaan chalayi gayin tatha woh ghayal ho kar shaheed ho gaye. Keval bharat ke itihas me nahi, balki Patna ke itihas me bhi 1857 ka yah din bahut nirnayak tha, kyunki iske baad shahar me sakht karwaiyan hui. Exam point: 3 July 1857 ko Patna ki Opium Factory ke Superintendent Dr. Lyell ko goli lag kar maut hui, jab woh Sikh sipahiyon se aage badh kar bhid ko daraana chahte the; woh Patna me hamle ka shikar hone wale pramukh angreji adhikari the; Commissioner Tayler ne Rattray ke Sikh bheje the.

qe: The day after the attack on the Roman Catholic church at Patna, letters found in whose house indicated the existence of a widespread conspiracy?
qh: पटना के रोमन कैथोलिक गिरजाघर पर हमले के अगले दिन किसके घर से मिले पत्रों ने एक व्यापक षड्यंत्र का संकेत दिया?
e: 3 July 1857 ko Patna me roman Catholic girjaghar par hamle ke baad Commissioner William Tayler ne sakht karwai shuru ki. Agle din Patna me Pir Ali ke ghar ki talashi se aise khat tatha kagaz mile, jinse pata chala ki shahar tatha kshetra me ek vyapak saazish yaani conspiracy chal rahi thi; yah saazish keval ek chhote hamle tak seemit nahi thi, balki sarkar ke viruddh ek bade vidroh ki yojna ka hissa lagti thi. Isi saazish ke silsile me shahar ke kai mukhya logon ko giraftar kiya gaya tatha mukadme chalaye gaye. Patna ke is daur ke pramukh police daroga Waris Ali bhi giraftar kiye gaye tatha unhe maut ki saza sunai gayi, jiske baad ve faansi par chadhte samay Delhi ke badshah ke naam ka naara lagate rahe. Exam point: girjaghar par hamle ke agle din Pir Ali ke ghar se mile khaton se Patna kshetra me vyapak saazish ka pata chala; Patna ke daroga Waris Ali bhi giraftar huye tatha unhe maut ki saza mili; Commissioner Tayler ne sakht karwaiyan chala kar shaanti bahal ki.

qe: Which of the fourteen persons sentenced to death for the Patna conspiracy of 1857 went to the gallows crying 'To the rescue, all friends of the King of Delhi'?
qh: 1857 के पटना षड्यंत्र के लिए फाँसी की सजा पाने वाले चौदह लोगों में कौन 'दिल्ली के बादशाह के सभी मित्र, बचाव को आओ' का नारा लगाता हुआ फाँसी पर चढ़ा?
e: Patna ke mukadme tatha girahf tariyon ke baad vidroh me shaamil mukhya logon par mukadma chalaya gaya tatha chaudah logon ko maut ki saza sunai gayi. Unme ek pramukh naam Patna ke daroga Waris Ali ka tha; unhe faansi di gayi, lekin faansi par chadhte samay unhone koi pashchatap nahi dikhaya aur Delhi ke badshah ke naam ka naara lagate rahe. Iske saath hi shahar me dabaav tatha saazish ke aise giroh bhi pakde gaye jinke paas hathiyar tatha khaton ke saboot mile the. Dhanapur ki chhawni se Sikh tatha angreji sena ke sahyog se kshetra me shaanti bahal ki gayi tatha Delhi ke vidroh ke saath rishta mitane ke liye sakht kadam liye gaye. Exam point: 1857 ke Patna mukadme me chaudah logon ko maut ki saza mili, jinme patna ke daroga Waris Ali bhi the; unhe faansi hui aur ve Delhi ke badshah ke naam ka naara lagate rahe; is daur me kshetra me anya saazishkaron par bhi mukadme chalaye gaye.

qe: Which force, then posted at Patna, was ordered to the spot and quickly dispersed the crowd of fanatics on 3 July 1857?
qh: 3 जुलाई 1857 को पटना में तैनात कौन-सी टुकड़ी मौके पर भेजी गई, जिसने उपद्रवियों की भीड़ को शीघ्र तितर-बितर कर दिया?
e: 1857 me Patna kshetra me angreji sarkar ke paas apni sena ki sankhya kam thi, isliye sthanik roop se Rattray ke Sikh sipahiyon par bharosa kiya jaata tha. 3 July 1857 ko jab dhol tatha hare jhande ke saath sattar ke aas-paas log Roman Catholic girjaghar par hamla karne daude, to Commissioner William Tayler ne turant Rattray ke Sikh sipahiyon ko mauke par bheja. Sikh sipahi tezi se pahunche tatha bhid ko jaldi bitha diya, chahe usi samay Dr. Lyell goli lagne se ghayal ho chuke the. Inhi Sikh sipahiyon ne 7 June ke baad Bankipore ke European nivasiyon ko bhi suraksha di thi, jab unhe Chajju Bagh me ikattha kiya gaya tha. Exam point: 3 July 1857 ko Patna ke roman Catholic girjaghar par hamle ke samay Captain Rattray ke Sikh sipahiyon ko mauke par bheja gaya tatha unhone bhid ko titar-bitar kar diya; inhi Sikh sipahiyon ne 7-8 June ko Bankipore ke European nivasiyon ki suraksha me bhi madad ki thi.

qe: On the morning of 25 July 1857, which General removed the percussion caps from the magazine to the lines of the British troops at Dinapore?
qh: 25 जुलाई 1857 की सुबह किस जनरल ने दानापुर में मैगज़ीन से पर्कशन कैप्स निकाल कर ब्रिटिश सैनिकों की लाइनों में पहुँचा दिए?
e: Patna me 3 July 1857 ki ghatna ke baad kshetra ki sena ko mazboot kiya gaya tatha General Lloyd ke adheen Dinapore ki chhawni ki command rahi. 25 July 1857 ki subah Lloyd ne ek savdhani ka kadam liya: unke aadesh par magazine me rakhe percussion caps yaani bandook chalane ke liye zaruri cap bahar nikal kar British soldiers ki lines me pahuncha diye gaye, taaki desi sipahi in hathiyaron ka galat istemal na kar sakein. Isi tarah Punjab se aayi sena tatha Rattray ke Sikh sipahiyon ki madad se Patna kshetra me vidroh ko phailne se roka gaya. General Neill aage Bihar kshetra ke abhiyan se jude, Major Adams ne 1763 me Patna ka kila liya tha tatha Colonel Forde ne 1759 ki Bedara ladai ladi thi. Exam point: 25 July 1857 ki subah General Lloyd ne Dinapore me magazine ke percussion caps British sipahiyon ki lines me pahunchwa diye; yah savdhani ka kadam isliye liya gaya ki desi sipahi in caps ka galat istemal na kar sakein; Lloyd ke paas Dinapore chhawni ki command thi.
